We were excited about ReAssure 3.0, but it has turned out to be less beneficial.😒 The premium is higher than previous versions, and key features now come as paid riders. For example, a ₹10L policy with ₹1L deductible gives only ₹10K discount, whereas the older version gave ₹16K—making the new one ₹6K costlier overall.

Insurance is becoming harder to afford with such changes.
